'''Mantraal''' is the [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Capital capital] of [[United Delet]], a [[New Ayre|New Ayrean]] economy, [[1708 FLLA World Cup|1708 FLLA World Cup]] champion, and the thirteenth-largest national economy by nominal [[List of countries by GDP (nominal)|GDP]] in the world. The city was the host of the [[1708 FLLA World Cup]], the first FLLA World Cup contested in [[New Ayre]], and of the [[1752 FLLA World Cup|1752 edition]] in which [[Praesyu]] defeated [[Verusa]] on penalties to win their second title.
